emily: Hi all, I9m Emily, starting today as Product Designer. Small blocker: no Figma invite yet and I can9t access the Research Playbook in Notion. Can someone help?

mira: welcome! :tada: DM your work email and I9ll ping IT for the org invite (we use redwood-design).

emily: sent: emily@redwood.ai

it-helpdesk: Got it — sending Figma invite to emily@redwood.ai and adding to team `product-design`. Check spam if you don9t see it in 10-20m.

design-bot: Figma invite sent to emily@redwood.ai for org `redwood-design`.

emily: saw the invite, thanks. Quick Q: where9s the canonical component library?

mira: open `RDW - UI Kit` under Files > Team > product-design. Also follow the tokens page for colors/typography.

emily: thanks! still can9t open Research Playbook (Notion says restricted).

sam_pm: adding you to product workspace and Research Playbook now. Also link: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Onboarding (has quick checklist).

tori_research: added emily to research calendar and shared `research-arch` drive link for recordings/transcripts. Welcome aboard!

emily: wonderful, feeling unblocked. Appreciate the quick help :)
